primary_papers.title: Freeze-in sterile neutrino dark matter in feeble gauged B-L model
primary_papers.notes: Assigned paper develops scalar and Z-prime freeze-in production in a feeble gauged B-L sterile-neutrino model.

source_chunks_or_sections.quote_or_summary: Paper considers gauged U(1)_B-L with sterile-neutrino dark matter produced by freeze-in, mainly through the B-L breaking scalar.
The model introduces three RH neutrinos for anomaly cancellation and a complex scalar that breaks B-L and gives Majorana masses.
The paper solves Boltzmann equations for N, Z-prime, and phi and finds feeble coupling ranges that reproduce h^2=0.12.
